calls.title: BlaBlaCar & GrowthBook Commercials
calls.summary: The evaluation of customer solutions is progressing slowly due to vacations, with the data team currently gathering simplified metric requirements. Plans for proof of concept testing in 2026 include selecting 1-3 solutions, while current A/B testing is limited to fewer than 50 experiments annually due to data team constraints. The proposed pricing for a base annual license is seen as high compared to budgets, with flexible options discussed. Integration with the data warehouse and reducing data team involvement are key factors, and GrowthBook's staged adoption is noted as beneficial. A follow-up meeting is scheduled to finalize criteria and discuss next steps for vendor selection and approvals from leadership.
calls.keywords: experimentation, A/B testing, data bottleneck, proof of concept, pricing negotiation, product analytics
